items.summary: A frontier AI model is trained in an AI data center, on tens of thousands of accelerators joined by a dedicated network, and every training step ends with all of them exchanging data at once. Between racks, that network is optical, and each of its four layers, from lasers to switches, runs a fixed or after-the-fact policy. Lasers sharing an enclosure, cooling, and power can fail together. At a fixed spare ratio, correlated failure provably caps a pool's availability however large it grows. items.summary: Streaming digital humans produce detailed video while continuing speech as new text arrives. High-resolution denoising is costly, and text updates can cause repeated or interrupted speech. We present TaoMate-HD, an autoregressive model for high-resolution audio-video streaming. For each short segment, or chunk, two denoising steps establish coarse video structure at low resolution. A final step refines the video to high resolution, with audio generated throughout the same trajectory. Each stage passes its audiovisual predictions to the same stage of the next chunk as history. items.title: The SIMPLE Law for Energy Cost of LLM Inference
items.summary: Generative AI is billed per token, yet tokens are not equally expensive. Each token enters the KV-cache and raises the cost of those that follow, so energy grows non-linearly along a sequence whose tokens look identical. No analytical model states what a token costs, and the most accurate SOTA model is a fit, not a law: it absorbs architecture into fitted coefficients, requiring per-LLM fitting. items.summary: Historical archives are invaluable for multidisciplinary research but remain inaccessible globally due to severe language barriers. While manual translation is prohibitively expensive and time-consuming, simply applying existing machine translation models is inadequate due to unique linguistic nuances and the temporal bias inherent in scarce human-labeled corpora. To address these challenges, we propose HERIT, a systematic domain-adaptation pipeline that leverages retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to generate high-quality pseudo-labeled data from abundant Hanja-Korean corpora. items.summary: Classification accuracy and true-positive and false-positive rates alone do not determine whether restarting an AI agent improves success. Using an exact alarm-to-action identity for an independent clean restart with zero monitoring overhead, we show analytically that a monitor with fixed 90% accuracy can swing from a five-percentage-point loss to a 35-point gain in success rate, depending solely on the replacement attempt's residual-budget success probability. items.summary: LLM agents for GPU kernel optimization sit at two ends of a structure-freedom tradeoff. Scripted agents fix what the model does at each step, via a learned policy, an optimization menu, or fixed roles, and are sample-efficient where the recipe applies and stall where it does not. Open-ended agents let a self-directed model mutate a population of kernels and pay for the freedom in trials: thousands of evaluations, repeated edits, and wrong candidates. items.summary: Reasoning substantially improves language models' ability to solve difficult problems, but long reasoning traces make these gains expensive. Efficient reasoning should express useful analysis in fewer tokens by reducing repetition and text that adds little value to solving the problem. Progress in proprietary models motivates this goal, yet their hidden scratchpads limit direct study of how it is achieved. items.title: DRAP: Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity for Continual Learning in Physical AI
items.summary: Continual learning in physical AI differs from conventional continual learning because small per-step policy errors can accumulate over a trajectory. Each deviation may move the agent outside the training distribution, increase subsequent prediction errors, and ultimately cause closed-loop task failure. items.summary: Streaming video-to-audio (V2A) generation is essential for immersive interactive applications. However, real-time constraints leave existing streaming V2A methods far behind offline models: (1) visual frontends shrink their receptive fields to cut look-ahead latency, severely degrading audio-visual alignment; (2) causal autoregressive diffusion backends denoise each audio patch in isolation, impairing audio quality. items.title: UniRestorer++: Scalable Universal Image Restoration with Multi-Granularity Degradation Modeling
items.summary: Universal image restoration aims to handle diverse degradations within a single model, but a reliable scaling strategy remains underexplored. Increasing backbone depth and width can lead to performance saturation, while degradation-aware specialization depends on accurate degradation estimation and is vulnerable to errors on out-of-distribution and real-world inputs. items.summary: Can a neural network learn to render 3D Gaussian splats on its own, with no rasterizer in the renderer? We present GaussianRenderFormer, a transformer that takes a set of Gaussians and a camera and outputs the image directly. items.summary: LLM-based agentic systems are increasingly combined with CoT reasoning to solve tasks that require accurate reasoning, external knowledge, and multi-step deliberation. Yet, explicit CoT incurs substantial generation overhead, while implicit CoT, which replaces textual rationales with compact continuous tokens, does not naturally support the explicit communication interface required for agentic tool-use. items.summary: Adversarial diffusion distillation has conventionally relied on image features for discrimination. We revisit this choice for multimodal diffusion transformers (MMDiTs), whose text stream becomes image-dependent through joint attention. We introduce Text-Stream Adversarial Distillation (TSAD), which exploits intermediate text-token states as a new adversarial representation. items.title: Hybrid Computer Use: A Unified Programmatic, Semantic, and Visual Interface for General Agents
items.summary: Computer-use agents increasingly tackle tasks ranging from everyday desktop activities to long-horizon professional workflows. Yet interfaces centered on screenshots and mouse-and-keyboard actions can impose a human-interaction prior, requiring repeated screen interpretation while leaving the computer's semantic and programmatic capabilities underexposed. items.summary: Coding agents powered by models such as GPT-6-Astra connect spatial reasoning with executable robot behavior, raising the question of how such agents can produce lasting improvements in robot capabilities from physical interaction. In this work, we study embodied recursive self-improvement (RSI) through real-world exploration, code refinement, and deployment using PyRUA-REAL, a framework in which coding agents retain interaction experience as persistent memory and reusable executable skills that inform subsequent exploration and improvement. items.summary: Probabilistic time-series forecasting requires models that simultaneously capture structured temporal dynamics, expressive uncertainty, and efficient inference, yet existing approaches fall short of this goal: latent dynamical models impose structure but rely on restrictive generation mechanisms, while modern generative methods such as diffusion and flow matching achieve flexibility at the cost of iterative and computationally expensive sampling. items.summary: Video dubbing aims to synthesize lip movements that match target speech while preserving the speaker identity, head pose, and background of a source video. items.summary: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. items.summary: Streaming video understanding requires models to repeatedly decide whether to respond or continue observing. Recently, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been applied to this setting, with existing approaches emphasizing reward design while retaining a single trajectory-level advantage across turns. items.summary: Looped transformers are a parameter-efficient alternative to standard transformers for language modeling. By reapplying the same layers across multiple loop steps, recent looped language models match the performance of non-looped models several times their size. items.summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has advanced generative model post-training in verifiable domains such as code and mathematics, but evaluating video quality, especially emotional expression, often depends on subjective aesthetics and has no uniquely correct target. items.title: On the Generalization Limitation of On-Policy Distillation for Post-RL Consolidation
items.summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) extends on-policy distillation (OPD) to consolidate capabilities from multiple teachers. Although prior work reports near-perfect in-distribution (IND) distillation performance, we find that this can mask incomplete capability consolidation beyond the supervised distribution. items.summary: Self-distillation methods for large language models with an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher already retain a history of student updates. items.summary: Vision-language-action models are typically built on a simple premise: perception is first compressed by visual encoders, and action reasoning begins only afterwards. Yet manipulation often hinges on precisely the visual signals most vulnerable to this abstraction, e.g., local geometry, boundaries, depth, and subtle state changes. items.summary: Researchers use large language models as agents in social simulations, where agents are prompted with observations and background information intended to shape their actions. items.summary: Reconstructing full flow fields from sparse sensors requires prior assumptions about unmeasured regions and physical variables. items.summary: AI agents are playing an increasingly important role in physics research. items.summary: Knowing that a pedestrian is occluded is useful to a robot even when the detector cannot recover the hidden pixels, but occlusion estimators are normally trained on occlusion annotations that deployment settings rarely have. items.summary: For many computer vision tasks, neural networks can be trained to produce a low average error, yet they still fail on seemingly simple scenes. items.title: 91% ≈ 0%？谷歌最新研究，戳破工程 Agent 的高正确率泡沫
items.summary: 41.3% 的设计项跨过安全门槛，复杂工程仍困于约束耦合。 作者丨 郑佳美 岑 峰 编辑丨岑 峰 在工程世界里，91% 的正确，有时和 0% 的交付能力没有区别。 一条电缆桥架在机房顶部穿过消防管线，就能让几十页正确的计算书失去交付价值。载流量算对了，电压降符合要求，设备选型也有依据，但进入三维空间后，几套系统争夺同一段净空，工程师只能退回方案。 AI Agent 能快速完成局部计算，工程项目却不会按计算题的边界运转：一处调整牵动另一处，刚核验过的结果也可能随修订失效。 Google 与 Mercor 近日发布的 Physical-Engineering's Last Exam（PLE），以 85 项机械、电气、土木与结构工程任务量化了这种落差。 在 56 项隐藏测试中，Claude Opus 5.5 搭配 Claude Code 得分 48.3%，而在共同创作任务中，它平均满足 91% 的单项约束，只有 41.3% 的交付设计项满足全部硬性安全与可行性要求。 更棘手的是，剩下的 9% 往往无法靠继续提高模型的计算能力解决。因为工程设计中的要求彼此关联，解决一个问题，可能又会产生新的问题。 PLE 的技术设计恰好揭示了这一困境：当局部能力已经足够强，工程 Agent 究竟还缺少什么？ 01 工程 Agent 正在遭遇可行域瓶颈 此前很多 Agent 评测采用逐项累积分数的方式，只要…

items.title: 更强的模型之外，ACM MM 2026还在关注什么？

items.title: 上海交大邓志杰：扩散语言模型，怎样才能又快又好
items.summary: 从基础路线到系统优化，讲解如何将并行潜力，转化为实际速度。 作者丨张璐 编辑丨 张驰 写作往往伴随着整体构思、局部推敲和反复修改。一句话中的用词，既取决于前文，也可能受到后文的影响。由此出发，语言模型的生成过程，是否也可以在多个位置同时展开，再逐步补全文本？ 在前不久的CNCC 2026上，上海交通大学副教授邓志杰以“扩散大语言模型方法及应用”为题，围绕一个核心问题展开讨论：能否在保证生成质量的同时，让扩散语言模型生成得更快？ 从LLaDA、Dream的基础路线，到跨块并行生成、后训练和推理系统优化，邓志杰梳理了将并行潜力转化为实际速度的多种方法。 他强调，评价效率既要看每轮能够生成多少token，也要计入每轮耗时，并结合答案正确率、代码通过率考察生成质量。演讲最后，他介绍了相关方法在流式视频、语音修复、多模态与智能体中的应用探索。雷峰网 以下为演讲主要内容。 01 语言生成可以在多个位置展开 我们写一本书，往往先写一遍，再反复重写。修改前面的内容时，会联系后面的章节；推敲“僧推月下门”还是“僧敲月下门”，也需要结合上下文。这说明，创作文本并不一定严格遵循从左到右的顺序。 扩散语言模型把这种想法付诸实践：同时预测多个缺失位置，逐步补全文本。这次分享主要讨论，怎样在保证生成质量的同时，尽可能提高生成速度。 自回归模型通过链式法则，将联合概率分布拆成一系列条件分布，标准解码依次预测下一…

items.summary: 11月5日消息，蚂蚁集团旗下AI助手灵光公布最新数据：自今年10月27日灵光2.0上线，一周内已帮助用户管理超116万项事务，执行超360万次任务。随着AI从“回答问题”走向“持续管事”，能主动帮用户管理日常事务的个人AI助理，正加速进入实际生活场景。目前，灵光用户已突破2000万。 10月27日，蚂蚁集团发布灵光2.0，推出“帮我管”功能，推动AI助理从“任务执行者”走向“事务管理者”。与传统AI助手不同，灵光2.0不仅能根据用户指令问答和完成任务，还能在获得授权后持续跟进，在关键节点主动提醒用户，推进事务进程。这一能力已应用于消费、出行、家庭等多个场景。 灵光能管事依托于跨会话记忆、长程任务调度、工具连接能力以及独立云主机，即使用户退出对话，相关任务仍可持续运行。 除此之外，开放生态是灵光实现跨场景事务管理的重要支撑。灵光的开放生态持续扩容，截至3日，灵光已连接支付宝、钉钉、飞书、微信读书、哈啰出行、邮箱、麦当劳等40项外部连接器。这意味着，灵光能跨平台完成信息获取、任务执行和持续管理。 据了解，灵光于2025年11月18日正式上线，凭借“一句话生成闪应用”备受瞩目，一周内下载量突破200万。此次2.0升级，则将产品能力从内容生成和单次任务执行延伸至长期事务管理。 业内认为，随着AI智能体技术发展，个人AI助理正从问答工具向具备持续执行能力的智能体演进。灵光最新公布的用户规模与…

items.summary: ![《在快 AI 时代，如何做一款慢产品？》文章封面]( https://cdn.tw93.fun/blog/pic/mole-product-cover-poem.png) 距离写完上一篇在 V 站发的 [Mole 出 Mac 版后，用户教会了我做产品]( https://www.v2ex.com/t/1239372) 已经过去两个多月。这段时间里，Mole 从 1.13 一路发到了 1.19 ，加上了 AI 工具清理和系统数据清理，Windows 版也在 10 月 14 日晚上发了出来，GitHub 上的 Star 一转眼也到了 73.9K 。 回头看这段时间，花时间最多的反而不是写新功能，而是测软件、补发邮件、改图标和文案这些在工程师看来挺划不来的蠢事情。 程序员天然喜欢做可扩展的事情，什么事都想着尽可能工具化、自动化、AI 化来解决，让自己偷懒。这两个月下来我的感受有点不一样，代码越来越便宜，谁都能很快做出一个能跑的东西，能拉开差距的，越来越是那些只有亲手做过才知道的细节。好在有了 AI ，这些原来要花大量人力的蠢事，现在一个人也做得完了。 ## 装了 853 款 Mac 软件来测卸载 我平时有点强迫症，电脑里的软件一直控制在 30 个左右。为了让 Mole 的卸载更彻底，清理残留的能力更强，最初那一轮我整理了国内外 300 多款 Mac 软件，下载下来 100 多个 G …
